title: Set a cache rule
summary: Laravel: Set a cache rule. Inspect Cache-Control with curl -i.
introduction: The header method adds response metadata. GET /note has a no-store rule.
learningObjectives: Set a cache rule with Laravel

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Set a cache rule
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/note", fn () => response("Practice note")->header("Cache-Control", "no-store"));

blocks.text: The response is built with text first, then its cache header is set.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A header is separate from the response body.
